summary: Reitar Logtech Holdings filed a Form 6-K containing a proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for September 3, 2026. The meeting agenda includes two proposals: a reverse share split consolidating every 25 class A and B ordinary shares into one share (par value changing from US$0.00000005 to US$0.00000125), with fractional shares rounded up; and a charter amendment to reflect the consolidation. The board has set a record date of July 31, 2026. This is a routine capital restructuring and meeting notice, not a special situation, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
